settings.section_subtitle: How two parents are changing the world of hydration, one drink at a time.

settings.text_content: I’m Luci. I was 16 years old when I first had the thought that what I was putting into my body might matter a lot more than I’d ever considered. The next decade was spent chasing fads, watching documentaries, going vegan, reading forums, visiting traditional and natural doctors, and trying to be “healthy” in our modern world. Unfortunately, despite my best efforts, I still felt stressed, hormonally imbalanced, and perpetually exhausted.

Fast forward to 2024. I’d just had my first child, and both my mind and body were completely out of sorts. The mental and physical exhaustion was taking an immense toll, and my typical healthy food and water simply wasn’t cutting it.

Why not?

The toxins present in our modern world (in the air, water, soil, and our everyday home products) deplete nutrient levels at a rate far more rapid than in the past. This is why supplementation (when done correctly) is almost always necessary to feel your best—unless you completely remove yourself from modern life.

I began a deep dive into supplements for daily energy, anxiety, and hormones, and after a year of experimentation I finally came upon a combination of clean, natural supplements and minerals that made me feel like the best version of myself.

I immediately started sharing my results with everyone I knew because I wanted them to feel their best too—but there was a problem. I was taking these supplements by mixing tiny spoonfuls of six different powders in tap water and throwing it back like a shot of cheap tequila.
settings.highlight_words: “Why don’t you turn this into a drink that actually tastes good?”

settings.text_content:
My husband Wyatt watched me drink this mixture every morning until one day he said: “Why don’t you turn this into a drink that actually tastes good?”

We spent hours that night in our kitchen mixing different blends, and by morning, Weller Co. was born.
settings.highlight_words: “Why don’t you turn this into a drink that actually tastes good?”

settings.text_content:
We perfected our first blend, Her’dration, and began selling it to friends, family, and coworkers. Wyatt and I waited in anticipation in those early weeks—Her’dration had changed my life for the better, but would it work for other women? Reviews started pouring in, and we knew we had made something special:

- “Nothing worked for my PCOS until I tried this.”

- “I can’t go a day without it.”

- “Keeps me hydrated and calm throughout my work day.”

- “My mood has evened out significantly.”

- “This has truly helped me live my best life.”
settings.highlight_words: Her’dration had changed my life for the better, but would it work for other women?

settings.text_content: We’d received the validation we needed, and it was no longer “Should we do this?” but instead “How do we get our drink mixes in front of every woman in America who just wants to feel good again?” That’s when the hard work began.

We built this business during nap times, after bedtime, and in every quiet moment of our already busy lives. Between two kids, custody battles, planning a wedding, building a house, and working through the kinks of newlywed life, we poured our heart and soul into building this business from scratch. Wyatt would come home from his 9–5, spend time with the kids, then go right into filling drink mix packets until he was exhausted. On every lunch break, he worked on building the website. I made orders, posted on socials, and put hundreds of miles on my car going around to give out samples, attend business conferences, and get supplies—all with two kids along for the ride. The temptation to give up and slow down our crazy lives was always there, but the amazing feedback from our customers gave us the fuel we needed to keep going.
settings.highlight_words: we poured our heart and soul into building this business from scratch

settings.text_content: Once we came out with Pro’dration—our electrolyte blend plus creatine that’s for everyone, not just women—and started receiving positive feedback on it too, we knew we were ready to do whatever it took to share our one-of-a-kind drink mixes with the whole world.

We joined Sprocket, a startup incubator based in Paducah, KY. I showed up at the first meeting with my one-year-old in tow—the only person there who brought a kid. We sat side by side at the conference table, already beginning to prove that there’s a place for families and children in the business world. We started going through their business course, refining our ideas and experimenting with new ones. The hardest part isn’t making the drink mixes—it’s figuring out how to get them in front of people and convince someone to take a chance on a product that’s never existed before.
settings.highlight_words: there’s a place for families and children in the business world.

settings.text_content: We aren't just a Liquid IV or LMNT alternative—we are an entirely unique hydration supplement. Sprocket has helped us greatly in this area and continues to do so, and we can’t thank them enough for their support.
settings.highlight_words: We aren't just a Liquid IV or LMNT alternative

settings.text_content: The second hardest part is money. It takes money to make money, as they say—and we’ve found that to be true. Wyatt’s 9–5 gives us the stability to spend time on the business, but taking it to the next level requires large sums to pay co-packing facilities, marketing consultants, licenses, and more. To avoid investors and loans at this stage, Wyatt and I started a side hustle cleaning industrial substations. I meet Wyatt when he gets off work at 4:30, and we scrub carbon black dust off breakers until midnight.

We believe in our products so much that we’re willing to sacrifice our precious free time and energy to fund the future of Weller Co. To us, it’s a small price to pay for the freedom to grow our company how we choose.

We aren’t an already established company, trust fund kids, or from a big city. We’re small-town, middle-class, normal parents—just like most of you. We solved a problem in our own lives and, in the process, created the most unique hydration blend on the market. I often think to myself, “Why hasn’t anyone done this before?” and I’ve realized the answer: no one was willing to take the risk and put in the hard work like we have. We won’t stop until we’ve shown the world that hydration doesn’t end with electrolytes—it’s only the beginning.
settings.highlight_words: We won’t stop until we’ve shown the world that hydration doesn’t end with electrolytes—it’s only the beginning.

settings.step_description: Mineral-rich salt, potassium, and magnesium restore mineral balance and help your body pull water into cells. The sodium/potassium ratio optimizes fluid movement, so hydration actually sticks instead of flushing through.

The best wellness support is the one you’ll actually stick with. Her’dration is gently sweetened with organic debittered stevia and flavored with organic fruit powders (NO natural flavors), creating a refreshing taste that makes daily use easy and realistic.

Mineral-rich salt, potassium, and magnesium restore mineral balance and help your body pull water into cells. Pro’dration uses a higher level of sodium and potassium to optimize fluid movement even more, so hydration actually sticks instead of flushing through.
Creatine helps your muscles make energy more efficiently, so you can feel stronger, recover better, and perform longer.
L-Theanine helps quiet stress signals while magnesium supports relaxation in the nervous system, working together to promote clearer thinking and steady focus.

Creatine doesn’t just support muscles — it also supports the brain’s energy needs. Paired with electrolytes, it can help with mental clarity, focus, and cognitive resilience, which can be especially valuable during pregnancy, postpartum recovery, breastfeeding, and seasons of sleep deprivation.
